0 SIMPLE CUBE TEST – three 2 x 2 bricks acting as unit cubes
0  - A and B only touch faces (no overlap)
0  - B and C are slightly interpenetrating for overlap detection
 
0 BRICK A – origin cube at (0, 0, 0)
1 1 0 0 0  1 0 0  0 1 0  0 0 1  3003.dat

0 BRICK B – shifted one full stud in X (touching A but not overlapping)
1 1 20 0 0  1 0 0  0 1 0  0 0 1  3003.dat

0 BRICK C – shifted by 30 LDU in X (overlaps B by 2 LDU)
1 1 50 0 0  1 0 0  0 1 0  0 0 1  3003.dat
